# swaylock

The lock screen (super+l, and after 5 min idle).

swaylock has no include, so its whole `config` is rendered from the palette.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`swaylock/packages`): `swaylock`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/swaylock/config`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `swaylock/.config/swaylock/config.tmpl` → `swaylock/.config/swaylock/config`: `accent`, `bg_desktop`, `border_hairline`, `error`, `fg_secondary`, `name`, `slug`
